name: David McAllister - Après le § 34 - Am 56
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 34a. Stresses that, in order to become more reliable and more autonomous in the fields of security, defence and technology, the EU and the Member States should give priority to defence capabilities designed, developed and produced within the EU, and should encourage joint procurement and investments that strengthen the European defence technological and industrial base, and reduce strategic dependencies on non-EU countries,
